steps.title: Open the dashboard
steps.narration: The dashboard displays a ready status and confirms the system is initialized with seed data.
steps.point_out: The top-right badge shows a green Ready state; the page shows 'provider: seed'

steps.title: Start a simple backfill job
steps.narration: Navigate to the Data Manager to run a backfill. We'll start with a single date range.
steps.point_out: The Data Manager page loads with the backfill form ready to use.

steps.title: Enter dates and start the backfill
steps.narration: Backfill a small, single-day range to see how the system handles zero-work scenarios.
steps.point_out: After the job finishes, reload to see the job summary explains why no work was needed—'2 non-trading'.

steps.title: Set end date and start
steps.narration: Complete the range and trigger the backfill to run.
steps.point_out: The job progresses to completion; the system explains what it did.

steps.title: Start the job
steps.narration: Click Start to queue the backfill.
steps.point_out: Job progress panel updates as the job runs.

steps.title: View the completed job in history
steps.narration: After the job finishes, reload the Data Manager to see its summary. The system explains that it found 2 non-trading days—zero work needed.
steps.point_out: Run history shows the completed job with its explanation: '2 non-trading'.

steps.title: Run a wide date range without rejection
steps.narration: This iteration removed any per-run date range cap. We'll backfill a full year plus—412 calendar days—to prove the system accepts it.
steps.point_out: The wide range (2025-06-01 to 2026-07-17) is accepted and begins processing.

steps.title: Set the wide range end date
steps.narration: Enter the end date for the 412-day range.
steps.point_out: The form accepts both dates without complaints.

steps.title: Start the wide backfill
steps.narration: Submit the 412-day range. No 'date range too large' error appears; the job begins processing.
steps.point_out: The job shows it is running and accepting the full, wide range.

steps.title: Navigate to Stocks
steps.narration: Tour the main surfaces to verify they load quickly and stay responsive. Start with Stocks.
steps.point_out: The Stocks page renders with the list of available symbols.

steps.title: View a stock detail page
steps.narration: Each symbol loads its details on demand, avoiding unnecessary preloading.
steps.point_out: AAPL details render with its chart and metrics.

steps.title: View the Evidence page
steps.narration: The Evidence page loads with stored backtest results, never recomputing on the fly.
steps.point_out: Forward-tested evidence values display from storage.

steps.title: View background compute disclosure
steps.narration: Return to the Data Manager to see the background compute panel. It discloses any in-flight aggregation work and its scope.
steps.point_out: If work is running, the panel lists the window with elapsed time and horizon progress; it states the work is 'process-lifetime only, never persisted'.
